author: evacfk
description: Automatically hides long-inactive members behind a Lurker role, stripping their other roles and restoring them when they post in a designated reactivation channel.
short: Auto-hide inactive members behind a Lurker role.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores member IDs, role IDs, and last-message/reaction timestamps to determine inactivity. No message content is stored.
